text:
eli: FYI CI is failing on the gitops helm lint for the gpu-overlay merge, looks like some overlays are turning nodeSelector into null and scheduler falls back :(

rachel: :eyes: reproing locally now with `helm template` against the eu overlay

sam: can you paste the exact helm command you used?

eli: `helm template charts/compute --values values/base.yaml --values values/overlays/eu.yaml | kubectl apply --dry-run=client -f -`

eli: output shows `nodeSelector: null` in the rendered podspec for the gpu-pool deployment, but base has nodeSelector set, overlay is supposed to merge/override

rachel: hmmmm, I think the overlay uses an emptyMap override and our helper coalesce is returning `nil` when path exists but is empty. I hit this before with `default` vs `coalesce` differences in sprig.

infra-bot: lint error from values.schema.json: "nodeSelector": expected object, got null at /profiles/gpu/pools/0/nodeSelector

sam: CI treats that as a hard failure so the gitops pipeline blocks the rollout. This started after the kustomize-like overlay helper landed (PR #412).

eli: suspecting the helm helper `mergeIfNotEmpty` introduced a code path that uses `hasKey` then returns `nil` instead of `{}` when overlay map is an empty file. Patch idea: ensure overlays coerce empty map to `{}` before merge.

rachel: quick patch suggestion in templates/_helpers.tpl:
```
{{- define "rd.mergeSafe" -}}
{{- $base := .base -}}
{{- $overlay := .overlay | default dict -}}
{{- if eq $overlay nil }}{{- $overlay = dict -}}{{- end -}}
{{- mergeOverwrite $base $overlay -}}
{{- end -}}
```
This forces overlay to be a map, so nodeSelector won't become null.

sam: that looks reasonable. We should also update values.schema.json to allow null? I prefer not, that masks bugs.

eli: agree don't relax schema. Instead add a unit test in chart CI that runs `helm template` with empty overlay file and asserts `nodeSelector` exists or is omitted (not null).

rachel: also noticed the scheduler fallback issue: when nodeSelector null appears, autoscaler picks wrong node pool and we saw 30% higher cost in the eu cluster last week. Not tolerable.

sre-oncall: can we add a temporary admission webhook reject rule for pods with nodeSelector: null? Might be heavy-handed but would stop bad manifests from promoting.

sam: prefer fix in chart + CI unit test + backport to active release branches. If we want a short-term guard, add a Kustomize/GitOps pre-commit hook that runs `jq`/`yq` to fail on `nodeSelector: null` entries.

eli: I'll open a small PR with the helper change + test and a follow-up PR for the pipeline hook. Planning to target stable and release-1.2 branches.

rachel: thanks. tagging @sam for review and @sre-oncall for visibility. I'll run a quick canary once patch lands. :shipit:

sam: TY. If anyone hits related failures, search for `mergeIfNotEmpty` in the repo — that's our suspect.

eli: PR link once ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/charts/pull/679 (draft)

infra-bot: created issue #1284 to track rollout and cost regression analysis

sre-oncall: keep an eye on eu GPU capacity metrics after the patch, we saw pod evictions yesterday that may be related.

eli: will do a post-merge smoke check and report back here with screenshots of `kubectl get pods -o wide` for the canary cluster.
